Environment · World

Wildfires rage across Europe, causing destruction and fatalities

Wildfires have erupted across several European locations amid a heatwave. In Belgium, the largest wildfire on record has burned 3,000 hectares and is advancing towards the German border, with Europe sending firefighting aircraft. Greece has also experienced significant fires, with two elderly individuals dying on the island of Salamina. In the UK, "apocalyptic scenes" were reported as fires swept through homes in the West Midlands, prompting thousands of emergency calls and an emergency alert sent to millions in England and Wales.
